subject: Film & Cinema
title: Space Opera: Myth Among the Stars
description: A short lesson to help you apply Space Opera: Myth Among the Stars.

hook.text: Star Wars opened with a spaceship so large it filled the entire screen. Jaws dropped.

buildup.text: Space operas blend ancient mythology with futuristic settings and epic scale.

discovery.text: Lucas borrowed from Kurosawa, Flash Gordon, and Joseph Campbell's hero's journey.

twist.text: The science in space operas is mostly wrong — but the emotions are exactly right.

climax.text: Dune, Guardians of the Galaxy, and countless others follow the path Star Wars blazed.

punchline.text: Space opera is fantasy in a spacesuit.

quiz.question: What did George Lucas draw inspiration from for Star Wars?
options: Kurosawa films and Joseph Campbell's mythology
